summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a 6-K reporting periodic buyback program activity under a second tranche of €3.5 billion multi-year plan running to 2030, disclosing daily purchases on Euronext Milan from April 13-17, 2026 totaling 39,037 shares for €11.8 million at average €303.30/share. Additionally, it assigned 95,273 treasury shares to employees and executed a sell-to-cover cross trade for tax withholding. As of April 17, treasury held 17.46 million shares (9.00% of total common, 9.39% including special voting). This is a routine capital return disclosure of ongoing open-market repurchases, not a special-situation event like a tender or going-private. Watch for continued execution pace vs. authorization.
